This game honors the Warhammer 40K franchise with brutal amounts of blood and violence. The power armors are stupidly big, the orcs swarm you at every chance they get with improvised weapons, and every gun in the game feels like it delivers a massive blow with each shot, even the basic pistol.

With a varied arsenal of weapons, both ranged and melee, purging heretics has never been more satisfactory. Executions are a spectacle to watch and every weapon has it's own advantages and type of usage. The campaign is very short, about 5 hours, but I didn’t mind as there is constant action and the pace is handled very well giving you new weapons and increasing the challenge.

Great game that delivers exactly what you would expect from a Warhammer 40K shooter: Big guns, hordes of enemies, and over the top violence. Totally worth it if you can get it for cheap on one of the many sales.

[b]Overall Score: 7.5/10[/b]
